config.label: API key for solving
config.description: API key for solving. Optional — the inspect_page tool works without one, so the server is useful before you have an account. A free sk_test_ sandbox key needs no card.

config.label: API base URL
config.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.solvegate.io.

config.label: Where inspect_page runs
config.description: Where inspect_page runs. Defaults to https://solvegate.io.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

config.label: How long solve_turnstile waits for a pending solve, in milliseconds
config.description: How long solve_turnstile waits for a pending solve, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.
